reasoning_traces.think:
The core data engineering primitives form a layered system: ingestion and validation ensure data fidelity, readiness scorecards enforce launch safety, and build queues govern workflow. These map into GSI’s probabilistic trust model through validation scores and into GSE’s deterministic task engine through state transitions. Failure modes include ingestion lag, unverified P0 data, and stale build states. Each primitive exhibits a duality between operational control and systemic risk—e.g., validation ensures trust but fails when freshness thresholds breach. The system's robustness depends on feedback loops from telemetry to scorecards and back to build decisions.
